about: Gallery orbits for the word-calculus check (TASK-M3-30): the initial conditions, periods and free-group words of ten periodic orbits as printed in Table I of the source, numbers and words only. Units are the table's: G = 1, m1 = m2 = m3 = 1. Each orbit starts collinear with x1 = (-1, 0), x2 = (1, 0), x3 = (0, 0), v1 = v2 = (vx, vy), v3 = -2 (vx, vy); 'T' is the period. 'printed' is the word as the table prints it, 'word' the same word written out. The table's body 3 starts in the middle; the check puts it at our body 1 (symbolic_dynamics_contract section 1, 'The body map'). The same ten rows are in fixtures/crossings/prl_orbits.json's 'table_i' (TASK-M3-16), which the check holds this file to.
source: M. Suvakov and V. Dmitrasinovic, 'Three Classes of Newtonian Three-Body Planar Periodic Orbits', Phys. Rev. Lett. 110, 114301 (2013), Table I. Only the published numbers and words are reproduced here, not the paper.
